production.scope: One frozen full willow owner, one frozen full stone owner with its three real PBR maps, one full R2 understory owner, one shared 182-placement R2 shore community. Two willow and two old stone context parts use exact live world matrices and shared source attributes. No juniper, whole terrain, renderer or archive is constructed.

layout.composition: Unequal west crescent, short middle fan and east open crescent; two unchanged willow contexts and two full-depth water-view windows

materialProvenance.method: Only frozen material/texture constructors evaluated with nonrendered metadata placeholders; real texture arrays must be the verified full-resolution cached pilot pixels at runtime.
